defect: clock-mux switching protocol and source-clock relationship are unstated
rationale: The mux can expose either unrelated source clock, but the RTL does not establish whether sel_i is a static strap, a synchronized glitch-free request, or a changing board signal. The logically-exclusive clock model is therefore undecidable without the environment's switching protocol.

provenance.adaptation: Reduced the two-input mux to a dynamic selector and a single output register, leaving the selector protocol external.

author: gpt-5.6-luna

labels.by: claude-sonnet (blind second labeller, design and constraints only)
labels.note: Standard exclusive-group clock-mux constraints; each clock has its own delays and no cross-clock path exists (low confidence).

Logical exclusivity describes mode intent but the combinational mux has an unconstrained dynamic selector. No static-selection or glitch-free switching contract establishes that the exception is valid.
